assessments.reasoning: The dated Recommendation separates the formal optional Static Typing Feature and the exact interpretation under absent-feature conformance. It uses subsumption with the feature and empty intersection plus possible deferral without it.

challenge.method: Challenge the wording with an inferred type that partly overlaps the required type, a disjoint inferred type, and a deferred type check without the feature. Compare the processing model and the feature conformance text.
challenge.results: The partly overlapping but non-subsumed case requires a static type error with the feature and disallows this particular static type error without it. A disjoint case may be reported at that stage without the feature, and the rule permits deferral. Other categories of errors remain distinct.

limitations: The source is the exact acquired W3C edition identified by the evidence record. The observed 2021 metadata notice and independently inspected linked context do not supply a different normative edition.
The dated requirement addresses this comparison and normative conformance only. It does not identify a given processor’s feature or error-reporting behavior.
